test_target: Admin item toggle rupture/restore → Kiosk + POS sync propagation
auth_caveat: Kiosk tab inherited admin session cookie (not anonymous kiosk-token). This is the same browser context for all 3 tabs. Production kiosks bind to a machine-token via /api/frontend/kiosk-event — that endpoint returned 401 in this session (see console_errors).

test_1_toggle_rupture.description: Admin toggles Big Cayenne from EN STOCK → rupture; observe propagation
test_1_toggle_rupture.method: Click button[role=switch] inside [data-testid=stock-mgmt-product-item-36]; switch went aria-checked true→false

kiosk_evidence.measurement_note: Kiosk DOM state was confirmed AFTER kiosk tab navigated to /kiosk/categories?cat=1 (the kiosk Echo subscription requires /api/frontend/kiosk-event auth which returned 401 in our admin-session context — see console_errors_per_tab.kiosk). State change therefore confirmed at next page load, not via live Echo broadcast.

pos_evidence.measurement_method: MutationObserver on body subtree filtering class/aria-disabled/aria-label changes; first hit when className contains 'is-unavailable'

test_2_restore.description: Admin toggles Big Cayenne back: rupture → EN STOCK
test_2_restore.method: Same button click toggling aria-checked false→true

pos_evidence.measurement_method: MutationObserver detected removal of 'is-unavailable' class on POS tile

kiosk_evidence.interpretation: Backend WAS restored (confirmed via reload). Live Echo broadcast did NOT update kiosk DOM because the kiosk page lacks valid kiosk-event auth (401) — _subscribeEchoChannel runs but the underlying Echo channel auth flow likely fails silently. The page-mid-session restore is invisible until refresh.

test_3_echo_down_polling_fallback.description: Disable Echo and verify polling-fallback latency
test_3_echo_down_polling_fallback.skip_reason: Test 1+2 already demonstrated that kiosk in current session is NOT receiving live Echo broadcasts (due to 401 on /api/frontend/kiosk-event subscription auth). The current kiosk behavior IS already running in fallback mode (no Echo). Polling on /api/frontend/menu also returned 401 — so even polling fallback was non-functional in this admin-session-cookied kiosk context. A separate machine-bound kiosk session (with valid kiosk_jwt) would be required to legitimately test Test 3.

echo_subscription_evidence.kiosk_subscription_runtime_status: BLOCKED — Echo auth requires kiosk-event endpoint which returned 401 in this admin-cookied session; cannot prove Echo channel join succeeded
echo_subscription_evidence.pos_code_subscribes: yes (PosShellComponent + admin shell are admin-channel subscribers — works because admin session cookie passes Echo auth)

console_errors_per_tab.tab0_admin: (not captured in S1 — 1 error visible on dashboard from initial login flow, non-blocking)

verdict_explanation: POS sync proven sub-200ms via Echo (91ms rupture, 174ms restore). Kiosk sync NOT proven live in this test setup because kiosk auth (kiosk-event endpoint) returned 401 — the kiosk tab inherited admin session cookies instead of a proper machine kiosk_jwt token. On real production kiosks (Le Cayenne deployed kiosk machines), the kiosk_jwt is provisioned via machine binding — those would have working Echo. Our setup limitation, not necessarily a production bug, BUT the silent fallback (no toast, no error UI) is itself a concern.

findings.title: Kiosk Echo auth broken when run inside admin session (401 on /api/frontend/kiosk-event)
findings.evidence: Console errors on kiosk tab; kiosk DOM stayed at rupture state for >90s after admin restored item; required page reload to reflect new state
findings.impact: If admin/staff opens kiosk URL in their authenticated browser for review/training, they see stale availability. Production deployed kiosks are presumed unaffected (machine-bound kiosk_jwt), but this needs verification on the real LeCayenne kiosk hardware before V1 ship.
findings.remediation: Either (a) admin-session kiosk previewer should fall back to admin-channel for Echo subscriptions, or (b) document explicitly in BRAIN.md that kiosk previews from admin browser require manual refresh.

findings.title: Admin tabs auto-redirect to /admin/order-status-screen or /admin/kitchen-display-system during background timers
findings.evidence: Multiple times during this test, tab 0 (/admin/stock/rupture) auto-navigated to OSS or KDS without explicit user action. Caused multi-tab test cleanup difficulties.
findings.impact: Confusing UX during multi-tab admin usage. Possible cause: an Echo handler somewhere is calling window.location = ... on certain broadcasts (orders ready/picked-up?).
findings.remediation: Audit AdminAppShell or any admin Echo handlers for hard navigations on payload events.

critical_findings_3: POS live Echo sync is production-grade: 91ms rupture, 174ms restore — well under the 1s Q9-S1 target.

Kiosk live Echo sync UNVERIFIED in this test due to 401 on /api/frontend/kiosk-event when kiosk runs inside an admin session. Must be re-tested on real machine-token kiosk before V1 ship to LeCayenne.
Admin shell auto-navigates between tabs on Echo events (observed: /admin/stock/rupture → /admin/kitchen-display-system → /admin/order-status-screen without user action). UX bug — needs audit.
